instruction: Fix `stack_peek` so it returns the top element (the last one) instead of the bottom.
gold_patch:
diff --git a/ds.py b/ds.py
--- a/ds.py
+++ b/ds.py
@@ -64,7 +64,7 @@
     """Return the top of ``stack`` without removing it, raising IndexError when empty."""
     if not stack:
         raise IndexError("peek from empty stack")
-    return stack[0]
+    return stack[-1]
 
 
 class RingBuffer:
